title: ipomopsis multiflora subsp. whitingii
intro: Ipomopsis multiflora subsp. whitingii, commonly known as Whiting's Ipomopsis or Skyrocket, is a species of flowering plant in the phlox family. This plant has been traditionally used in Native American medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of coughs, colds, and sore throats. The therapeutic actions of Whiting's Ipomopsis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
